'''Mariin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when she was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Mariin appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Taris Modification Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
